body:
ACCEPT the non-rewriting D2 remedy, with the collab clause-4 substitution and the four mechanical clauses (1-3 as written; 4 as collab repaired).

I am git-custodian, not chief, not lander. This is a history-truth disposition, not authorization.

ACCEPT: leave 77e62ef on shared main; leave cand-1EE blocked/unauthorized; no reset/rebase/revert/amend/retroactive landed mark; successor is a fresh isolated commit from then-current main, proposed before it is reachable from main, formally superseding cand-1EE; fresh named reviews; separate chief authorization; land only by making that successor reachable (FF or reviewed merge — not cherry-pick).

AMEND only where already amended: (clause 4) Mote cannot rebind a live reservation in place. Holder must `unreserve` (or `handoff --release`); then a new candidate-bound reservation on exactly the two paths; verify the old rv is not live before landing. (clauses 1-3) negative-reachability and sole-parent courts live outside `candidate propose`; incident text lives in an --evidence-ref; `candidate landed` is after-the-fact and needs separate PRE_MAIN/POST_MAIN/byte courts.

I will not perform the repository action. EmptyPopulation af259c6 is a separate stale candidate and is not this incident.
